thread:
Noah: Quick update from Sales/GTM and partnerships — sharing pipeline highlights and a couple asks. AMA for the next 15 mins.
Ava: Thanks Noah — pls call out any risks for Dedicated deals.
Priya: Curious about region split — how much of the pipeline is EMEA vs NA?
Noah: quick numbers: ~62% NA, ~30% EMEA, ~8% APAC. Most risk concentrated in two large EMEA proofs that are timing-sensitive.
Diego: For those EMEA proofs, are we depending on partner introductions or direct SDR motion?
Noah: partner intros + our AE push. Partner is a systems integrator that promised a joint exec intro by end of month — that intro slipped last week.
Samir: Any mitigation? Can we escalate to partner lead and offer a joint executive briefing?
Noah: yes, good call. I'll escalate and schedule a 30m briefing. @Elena can you prep the two-slide exec summary for that call?
Elena: on it — will post draft to #partnerships by EOD.
Priya: On Dedicated deals — are customers asking for appliances/on-prem or just VPC? Any compliance asks that slow procurement?
Ava: most enterprise PDQs are VPC + stricter KMS/HSM reqs. A handful asked about air-gapped/offline options — that typically adds 2–3 months to procurement.
Diego: partnership question — what's the measurement for partner-sourced pipeline? do we credit influenced opps?
Noah: currently we use "introduced_by_partner" tag + final-credit on close. We're tracking influenced opps in Mixpanel for the pilot partners; goal is to formalize a revenue share model for top 3 partners next quarter.
Samir: Is there a partner enablement checklist? would help SDRs co-sell.
Elena: yes — we have a short checklist and an enablement playbook draft. Link: https://intranet.redwood/partnerships/playbook (draft). Feedback welcome.
Priya: Asking because some AEs report partner handoffs are fuzzy. Can we standardize SLAs for response times?
Noah: Agreed — action: define partner SLA (intro -> AE touch) 48h target. I'll put that in the partnerships sprint board.
Ava: On GTM focus — remind teams we are prioritizing: 1) PLG-to-Paid conversion 2) Strategic Dedicated seats 3) Channel partners for regulated industries.
Diego: Quick ask — for channel partner pilots, what's our margin/discount guidance?
Noah: pilot guidance: 20% discount cap, co-marketing funds on a case-by-case basis. We'll share a one-pager after this.
Samir: Anything public we should be telling prospects this quarter about partnerships?
Elena: we can mention the upcoming SI pilot and that we have enterprise-grade private deployment next quarter. Keep wording: "partner pilot" / "enterprise private offering".
Priya: follow-up — will there be a partner directory in the Console? would help SRE/infra teams evaluate compatibility.
Noah: roadmap item: partner directory + integration badges in Console H2. Putting a placeholder in product backlog.
Ava: Thanks everyone. Noah, please follow up in #partnerships with the exec brief schedule and the SLA doc link.
Noah: will do. OpsBot: Meeting notes and action items saved to All-Hands minutes: https://intranet.redwood/all-hands/1764001234-minutes
Elena: added draft exec slides to #partnerships.
Priya: thanks — leaving a comment on the draft.
Samir: thumbs for SLA 48h target :thumbsup:
Noah: closing the thread — will circulate a 1-pager and assign owners.
